title: Host Share of Loss and Claim-Free Relief across the Keyturn Shield Host Plans
content:
Every plan in the Keyturn Host Protection Plan ladder publishes its own deductible, the host's own share of each accepted loss, together with the claim-free discount that plan publishes on it, the number of consecutive claim-free months that earns the discount and the number of consecutive claim-free months published for a full waiver.

| Plan | Deductible, USD | Claim-free discount, percent | Qualifying months | Waiver months |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 3000 | 10 | 24 | 0 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 2500 | 12 | 24 | 0 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 1500 | 15 | 18 | 0 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 750 | 18 | 18 | 36 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 500 | 20 | 12 | 24 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 0 | 25 | 12 | 12 |

### Notes on the columns

The deductible falls as the earnings share falls, from 3000 on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan to nothing at all on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan, where the published figure is 0. The claim-free discount runs the other way, from 10 percent on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan to 25 percent on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan. The qualifying period is 24 consecutive claim-free months on the two highest-share plans, 18 on the Keyturn Shield 80 and 75 Host Plans and 12 on the Keyturn Shield 70 and 60 Host Plans. A waiver period of 0 months is published on the Keyturn Shield 90, Keyturn Shield 85 and Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plans; the Keyturn Shield 75, 70 and 60 Host Plans publish 36, 24 and 12 months respectively.

### Points of judgement

Which figures apply is settled by the plan the enrolment is written on and by nothing else: two vehicles of the same make belonging to the same host, written on different plans, carry different deductibles and different claim-free terms.
